faq.metaDescription: Ibibazo bikunze kubazwa kuri CarShare Burundi. Ronka vuba inyishu ku bijanye no gukodesha ibinyabiziga hagati y'abantu ku giti cabo mu Burundi.

items.question: Ukukodesha ibinyabiziga hagati y'abantu ku giti cabo bikora gute?
items.answer: CarShare Burundi ihuza abatunzi b'ibinyabiziga n'abantu bipfuza gukodesha ikinyabiziga. Abatunzi barashira amatangazo yabo hamwe n'amafoto, ibiciro n'uboneka. Abakodesheje barashobora kuraba amatangazo, gupanga ako kanya kuri interineti no gufata ikinyabiziga ahantu hemejwe.

items.question: Nokwiyandikisha gute kuri uru rubuga?
items.answer: Ukwiyandikisha ni koroshe kandi ni ku buntu. Ukanda gusa kuri 'Iyandikishe', utange amakuru yawe bwite, ikimenyetso kikwiye n'uruhushya rwawe rwo gutwara. Konti yawe ikimara kwemezwa, urashobora gutangura gukodesha canke gushiraho ikinyabiziga cawe.

items.question: Ni izihe nyandiko nkeneye kugira ngo nkodeshe ikinyabiziga?
items.answer: Kugira ngo ukodeshe ikinyabiziga, ugomba kwerekana: uruhushya rukwiye rwo gutwara (rw'igihugu canke mpuzamakungu), ikimenyetso gikwiye, hamwe n'ikarita ya banki y'intererano. Abatunzi bamwebamwe barashobora gusaba izindi nyandiko.

items.question: Ibiciro bishirwaho gute?
items.answer: Ibiciro bishirwaho ku bushake n'abatunzi bivanye n'ubwoko bw'ikinyabiziga, umwaka, ibikoresho n'ivyifuzwa. Urubuga rwacu rwerekana ibiciro bitomoye birimwo amagiye y'igikorwa. Urashobora kugereranya amatangazo mu buryo bworoshe.

items.question: Ni iki nkora igihe hari impanuka canke ikibazo?
items.answer: Igihe hari impanuka, vugana ako kanya n'ababuyobozi hanyuma umenyeshe ikibazo biciye kuri porogaramu. Ikinyabiziga kigomba kuba gifashwe n'ubwishingizi bwite bw'umutunzi wako, bwatangajwe ku bijanye no gukodeshwa — ni ubwo bwishingizi bukoreshwa, atari ubwishingizi bwa BudaxDrive. Igihe hari ikibazo, vugana ako kanya n'umutunzi w'ikinyabiziga.

items.question: Uburyo bw'intererano bukora gute?
items.answer: Intererano yemezwa imbere kuri ikarita yawe ya banki mu gihe co gufata ikinyabiziga. Umubare uratandukanira bivanye n'ikinyabiziga (bisanzwe hagati ya FBU 100,000 na 500,000). Iyi ntererano irekurwa mu buryo bwikora imisi 7 inyuma yo gusubiza ikinyabiziga, keretse hari ivyononekaye canke amakosa.

items.question: Noshobora guhagarika ipangwa ryanje?
items.answer: Ego, urashobora guhagarika ipangwa ryawe bivanye n'amabwirizwa yo guhagarika y'umutunzi. Bisanzwe: guhagarika ku buntu gushika amasaha 24 imbere y'itanguriro ry'ukukodesha, gusubizwa 50% hagati y'amasaha 24 n'amasaha 2 imbere, nta gusubizwa munsi y'amasaha 2 imbere.

items.question: Nshira gute ikinyabiziga canje mu kukodesha?
items.answer: Kugira ngo ushire ikinyabiziga cawe mu kukodesha: tegura itangazo ryawe hamwe n'amafoto meza, shiraho ibiciro n'uboneka bwawe, werekane aho utanga ikinyabiziga. Turasuzuma ikinyabiziga cawe n'inyandiko zawe. Rimara kwemezwa, itangazo ryawe rirasohoka kandi utangura kuronka ibisabwa.

items.question: CarShare Burundi ikuramwo amafaranga y'ivyunguzo?
items.answer: Ego, dukuramwo amafaranga y'igikorwa ya 15% kuri buri gukodesha kugira ngo tugwize ubufasha ku bakiriya, ugutunganya kwishura n'ugutunganya urubuga. Aya mafaranga aratomoye kandi arimwo mu giciro cerekanwa.

items.question: CarShare Burundi iraboneka mu bihe bihe?
items.answer: CarShare Burundi ubu iraboneka i Bujumbura, Gitega, Ngozi na Bururi. Turateganya kwaguka mu bindi bisagara vy'igihugu mu 2025. Kurikira amakuru yacu kugira ngo umenyeshwe ivyerekeye uduce dushasha.

items.question: Nvugana gute n'ubufasha ku bakiriya?
items.answer: Umurwi wacu w'ubufasha uraboneka kuva kuwa mbere gushika ku cyumweru kuva 7h00 gushika 22h00. Urashobora kudukorera kuri telefone +257 XX XX XX XX, kuri imeyili contact@budaxdrive.bi, canke biciye ku kiganiro co ku rubuga rwacu.

items.question: Ibinyabiziga vyafashwe ubwishingizi?
items.answer: BudaxDrive si sosiyete y'ubwishingizi: umutunzi wese agomba kwemeza ko afise ubwishingizi bwite bwemewe, bwatangajwe ku bijanye no gukodeshwa, imbere yo gutangaza ikinyabiziga ciwe. Ni ubwo bwishingizi bukoreshwa igihe habaye ikibazo — atari ukurindwa gutangwa na BudaxDrive. Turaraba ko igenzura ry'ikoranabuhanga n'ubwishingizi vy'ikinyabiziga bitarangiye imbere ya buri gukodesha.
